macos.guidance: Use Audio MIDI Setup or Loopback to create your routing. This JSON is a reference, not an importable Loopback preset. Match physical device names and sample rates; select the virtual device as an OBS audio input.

windows.guidance: Use the bus matrix as a reference and configure VoiceMeeter against your actual hardware. The bundled XML is a platform template; its compatibility with VoiceMeeter's Load Settings format has not been verified. Save a working preset from VoiceMeeter before trying any import. Check virtual audio devices separately in Windows Sound settings.

linux.guidance: Review the loopback configuration against your existing PipeWire setup before adding it. Executable presence does not prove the user audio service or any links are running. Keep a backup of your current configuration.

acceptance: In OBS, speak into the mic, play desktop audio and a local AI voice sample separately. Confirm each intended source moves its meter and reaches the recording track; avoid capturing the same source twice.
Record a short local sample and listen on headphones. Confirm usable relative levels, peaks below -1 dB and no clipping or dropouts.
With a call partner, confirm they cannot hear their own voice returned. Keep CALL-IN and AI-VOICE out of their own input routes.
In OBS Settings > Hotkeys, assign mic mute/unmute and any soundboard clip hotkeys. Test each key off-air and confirm the intended source changes or clip plays exactly once.
